lines.trans: Today I have a favor to ask you regarding casting.
It freezes like this sometimes when the signal is weak.
Because we are revamping the show from scratch, we want to go big.
Could we not just talk by phone instead?
Before a concert, he always keeps his phone switched off.
Producer Ra? It has been a long time.
Do you and I have any reason to be on the phone?
I thought we never would either, yet something just came up.
Someone claiming to be the youngest producer on your team came to see me.
What did you say? Where are you right now?
An urgent matter just came up for me right now!

meanings.note: Often used as a bound noun after -(으)ㄹ to mean 'when' or 'while'.

meanings.note: Humble 1st person plural pronoun used when speaking to superiors or in formal settings.

meanings.en: to do, to perform, to hold

meanings.note: Plain first-person singular pronoun used with friends, younger people, or subordinates; contracts to 난 with -는 and becomes 내가 before -가.

meanings.note: Used for time or order.

보다.gloss: to see, to watch; to take (an exam)
